ads_ratio.reason: BCE is a direct-listed foreign private issuer: one NYSE-traded BCE share is one common share, so no ADS conversion applies; per-share figures and the traded price are on the same basis.
ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-06, accession 0001193125-26-095004), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Common shares', trading symbol BCE, listed on the New York Stock Exchange — the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS

moat_against: The regulator is an erosion force: the CRTC wholesale fibre-access decision forced Bell to open its fibre network to rivals and BCE curtailed its own fibre build in response
No demonstrated pricing power: Bell CTS Canada revenue -4.0% YoY in Q2 2026, blended ARPU +0.7% only; legacy voice and linear TV decline structurally

No roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json (operating income untagged under IFRS) and a history of value-destroying capital allocation: impairments of C$2,190M (FY2024) and C$1,027M (FY2025) plus recurring severance programs
Leverage, not the franchise, drives policy: net debt $29,988M (engine, USD) against equity of C$23,310M; the dividend was cut from C$3.99 to C$1.75 annualized in May 2025 to repair the balance sheet
US growth is bought, not moated: Ziply Fiber operates in competitive US fibre markets outside the Canadian oligopoly's protection
moat_for: Regulated three-carrier Canadian oligopoly: spectrum licences and national fibre/5G networks are effectively irreplicable; BCE is Canada's largest communications company by revenue and connections
Sticky installed base: 4.91M Bell CTS high-speed Internet subscribers (Q2 2026) and postpaid wireless churn of 1.0% in Q2 2026, the lowest comparable level in three years
Margin stability through a cycle: gross margin 67.9-68.9% across FY2021-25 (fundamentals.json) and FY2025 adjusted EBITDA margin 43.6%, the highest in over 30 years
Content bundle: Bell Media / Crave (5.1M subscribers, +23% YoY in Q2 2026) bundled with connectivity raises switching friction
moat_justification: Regulated Canadian telecom oligopoly with spectrum and fibre/5G network scale and sticky subscribers (postpaid churn ~1.0%), but the regulator caps the moat (CRTC wholesale fibre access), pricing power is unproven (Canadian CTS revenue falling, ARPU ~flat), revenue has been flat for five years, and returns sit on a huge, repeatedly impaired asset base with high leverage. fundamentals.json carries no operating-income / roic_proxy series for BCE (IFRS tags), so the moat rests on margin stability (gross margin 67.9-68.9% over the last five fiscal years, adjusted EBITDA margin 43.6% in FY2025) rather than a demonstrated high-ROIC history.
name: BCE Inc.
one_liner: Regulated Canadian telecom oligopoly, moat 5/10 — real owner's earnings (base $2.52/share, 12.4% OE yield) but flat growth and net debt at 12.8x normalized OE cap the return: weighted IRR 14.3% and weighted IV@15% $19.20 sit just under the $20.38 price, so it clears 15% only at ~$19 or below — Tier C, sized to the bear end (bear IRR 10.3%).

sbc_override.ack_reason: Out-of-band by construction: the engine's sanity band anchors on the last FILED SBC value under its own tags and BCE has no filed value under any tag the engine maps (last_filed_value is null), so no in-band value exists. The C$90M is not an estimate — it is the FY2025 total share-based payments printed in Note 32 of BCE's own FY2025 financial statements, corroborated by the EDGAR IFRS companyfacts tag for the same concept.
sbc_override.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The filer's own Note 32 total for FY2025 (C$90M) fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. The true per-year series in the same note/tag is C$95M (FY2023) / C$84M (FY2024) / C$90M (FY2025), so applying C$90M overstates SBC in the median year (FY2024, true C$84M) and makes the 3-yr median base slightly conservative; the amount is ~0.4% of revenue and ~C$0.07/share, immaterial to the verdict either way.
sbc_override.source: BCE Inc. 2025 annual financial statements (filed with the Form 40-F for the year ended December 31, 2025, accession 0001193125-26-095004), Note 32 Share-based payments: total share-based payments included in operating costs were C$90M in FY2025 (RSUs and PSUs C$61M + ESP and DSUs C$29M) and C$84M in FY2024; EDGAR companyfacts carries the same series under ifrs-full ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactions (FY2023 C$95M / FY2024 C$84M / FY2025 C$90M), a tag the engine does not map, so sbc_tag is blank for every filed year. Value is in CAD as filed; the engine FX-converts at period-end rates.
